verdict.rationale: A government payroll-tax agency could plausibly publish official SDKs or client libraries for its e-filing and payment services, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes web-portal e-Services and electronic filing/payment channels (FSET, EFT/ACH), which are not SDKs. The probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and the transactional portal returns 403 to agents.
